method: Sinz sequential counters, N+(0)={1..d}, cubes on k=|N-(0)| with N-(0)={d+1..d+k}. Pigeonhole: n*d arcs so some in-degree is at least d. Each needed cube has a stored DRAT.
soundness: n=21 d=6 k=6 SAT with a checked C3-free model; n=24 d=7 k=7 SAT with a checked C3-free model. The encoder is not vacuously UNSAT.
